grh_85a93a47c9db03a97d2f.title: Duel at Lockwood
paragraphs: Gunfighter Wes Singer comes to Lockwood looking for a showdown with Britt, but young Sheriff Ben insists that stopping the trouble is his responsibility even if Wes is really after someone else. Britt refuses to let the sheriff be sacrificed simply to protect his own reputation. He finally confronts Wes at close range with a shotgun, explaining that Wes can fire first if he wants but cannot prevent Britt's blast from killing him in return. Faced for once with a duel in which surviving the first shot will not save him, Wes backs down and leaves Lockwood.

Other credited names include Jack Johnstone as director, Frank Burt as writer, and John Wald as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes. Characters credited in this version include [[character|Britt Ponset]].

paragraphs: Shayne is drawn into a family poisoned by years of hatred after Mark Sanderson becomes convinced someone is trying to kill him. paragraphs: After singing 'San Fernando Valley,' Gene tells of going undercover in Silver City as a Ranger investigating Jake Berdyck, a powerful local criminal accused of swindling and terrorizing residents.
